proof_body:
by
  intro p _ q r hq hr
  refine ⟨fun h => padicValRat.min_le_padicValRat_add h, fun h => ?_⟩
  have hs : q + r ≠ 0 := by
    intro e
    apply h
    have : r = -q := by linarith
    rw [this, padicValRat.neg]
  exact ⟨hs, padicValRat.add_eq_min hs hq hr h⟩
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (q r : ℚ), q ≠ 0 → r ≠ 0 → (q + r ≠ 0 → min (padicValRat p q) (padicValRat p r) ≤ padicValRat p (q + r)) ∧ (padicValRat p q ≠ padicValRat p r → q + r ≠ 0 ∧ padicValRat p (q + r) = min (padicValRat p q) (padicValRat p r))
